_comment: Operational control for every TeekHub loader in the wild. Edit and push;
the loader reads this before anything else, with a cache buster, so a
change reaches users on their next execute.
enabled      false kills every copy of the hub immediately.
keyRequired  false is keyless. Flip to true when the key gate goes live
- no user has to change their loadstring.
minVersion   loaders older than this refuse to run and tell the user to
message      shown on start. Use it for outages and announcements.
